title: Separate checks for separate properties
statement: A check certifies only the property it tests, so give structure, facts, design, text dependence and teaching quality each a blocking check of its own.
example: A generated question scored a perfect 1.0 for structure while a blind solver answered it 100% of the time without its passage.
detail: A structural benchmark scored a generated question 1.0 while a blind solver answered it 100% of the time without its passage, and a generator rewarded on that score converged on structurally valid leaked questions (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-merged-course/GENERATOR_DIRECTIVE.md`). The other way round, 13 of 13 rewritten items passed the blind gate but only 4 passed a quality rubric, because some tested the wrong standard or became mechanical ordering tasks (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-expansion-session-2026-07-08-codex/QUESTION_GENERATION_RETROSPECTIVE_2026-07-08.md`). For reading, the approved plan calls the leak check a build-time lint, not a comprehension guarantee, since finding the answer in the passage is the reading skill (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5_build_2026_07_02/approval_clean.md`). A check does not carry over by itself either: an item factory's certification evidence came from AP history, a different subject and grader, and an AP pipeline's fix removed the stimulus so the grader's leak probe was skipped, which a fact sheet calls grader-gaming (`grade3-reading/artifacts/PROPOSAL_REVIEW_2026_06_16.md`; `grade3-reading/artifacts/alpha-read-packager/FACTS_SHEET.md`). Require them all: a top score on one, such as a quality grade, says nothing about another, such as whether the question needs its text.
against: The 13 items passed the blind gate under a loosened bar, and that pilot was superseded and is not a production result (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-expansion-session-2026-07-08-codex/QUESTION_GENERATION_RETROSPECTIVE_2026-07-08.md`). The pilot's blind gate ran under a loosened bar and its quality review was a model's, not a person's (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0091-g5-question-generation-retrospective-codex-2026-07-09.qmd`), and an earlier ruling in the knowledge store, not cited here, set a passage-blind re-check aside as redundant because the set had already passed both graders. It can catch a blatant passage mismatch, and did once, though a subtler topic drift sits in its flip band and would not be reliably caught (`grade3-reading/artifacts/alpha-read-packager/v2_final_package/docs/COURSE_QUALITY_GATE_REPORT.md`, lines 254-256). the judge does veto on its own terms: a score is capped at 0.84 if a critical metric, factual or educational accuracy, is 0, and leaking is not among them (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0234-misc-artifacts-gate-eval-checks-recovery.qmd`, lines 27-31). Where the model lacked the facts, facts dominated: "Factual accuracy is the dominant kill — fresh-base 8B doesn't have Unit-1 facts." (aptraining-local/den-of-ideation/reports/validation_triage/20260527T132917Z_2026-05-27T1330Z_bm0zjn5z_n100_unit1_RAW_PROBE_REPORT.md.md, line 115); and on the same baseline as the 0/20, 94% of failed document tasks had factual_accuracy=0 (aptraining-local/den-of-ideation/reports/validation_triage/20260527T192220Z_2026-05-27T1922Z_v80b_n100_unit1_BASELINE_REPORT.md.md, line 108).

- InceptBench is NOT a leak gate (it scored leaking items 1.0). Never report the "0.932 vs 0.356 IB lift" (version-confounded).

The conversion succeeded where it treated "anti-leak" as only one layer of course-worthiness. The work failed or became fragile whenever it treated an item as done because it passed a local script, appeared in XML, had plausible text, or helped hit a count target.

Lesson: compare NODE to the closest matching node across the reference lessons (same type, max key-set Jaccard similarity), not page position, and judge voiced/silent as a separate pass — a key-set-only census missed 36 silent stems undetected.
Technical audio measurements do not establish musical quality, intelligibility under speech, or acceptable transitions.
This is a state-flow check, not rendered browser QA.
It cannot select source rights, prove that knowledge was taught before assessment, verify teacher-only data isolation in an app, or establish student learning.
Deterministic file checks can establish structure, traceability, and internal consistency.
NEVER ships on the strength of a style approval
